what: A string with no pluck of its own: send in any short sound and it rings at a pitch.
how: A short burst going round a loop of delay with filtering is how a string works. Anything you feed IN is put into the string and it rings at the PITCH you give it. A click or burst of noise sounds plucked; a drum or longer sound is turned into a string tone.

ins.in: The sound to excite the string (audio). Patch a DUST, a NOISE burst through a VCA, or a DRUM here.
ins.pitch: Pitch in octaves (1 volt per octave, 0 is middle C). Patch KEYS' pitch here.

knobs.tune: Shifts the pitch in semitones, -24 to 24 (two octaves down to two up), added to the pitch input.
knobs.nonlin: How non-linear the string is, -1 to 1. Zero is a plain string; positive or negative values add different kinds of bright, buzzy or bent character.
knobs.bright: How much high end stays in the ring, 0 to 1.
knobs.damp: How fast the ring dies away, 0 to 1. Low is a long ring.
knobs.drive: How hard the input is pushed into the string, 0 to 2. Higher is louder and rougher.

try: Patch DUST's out into KARPLUS's in, KEYS' pitch into KARPLUS's pitch and KARPLUS's out into OUT. Hold a note and hear a string being plucked at random.
